title: Concept: Session token in a data attribute
description: A data attribute that carries a bearer token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A token in markup is readable by any script on the page and persists in caches and saved pages, so it is weaker than a token held in memory only.
applicability: Deployments that render a data attribute that carries a bearer token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A token in markup is readable by any script on the page and persists in caches and saved pages, so it is weaker than a token held in memory only.
